title: Descent test: 700m up easy, 700m down at race grade
terrain: Cassinelli line from Dorga, home trail, out-and-back. ~10km, +700/-700, descent at 10-15% average, bail-out at every point

steps.target: Z1-Z2 easy climb 700m D+, hike it, 130-150 bpm
Z1-Z2 sustained 700m descent, poles, short stride, cadence 175+, 99-140 bpm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: the climb is transport, keep it under 150 bpm, no push. The descent is the session: 700m continuous at 10-15%, poles out from the top, short stride, cadence 175+, quiet feet. Same grade as the race's final 1250m.
GYM: hip abductor block, light, after.
FUEL: one Isocarb bottle across the session. No test today, Saturday was the test.
STOP RULE: quad soreness from Saturday is expected and fine. Lateral knee is not. First twinge, stop descending, walk out, report the same evening - it changes race-day descent strategy, not the training.
WHY: Rifugio Olmo is closed so the old two-descent weekend is gone, and Saturday's route only yields 767m of fragmented D-. This is the only sustained descent rehearsal before 12 September and the last eccentric load of the block. Fresh legs, known trail, bail-out everywhere: that is deliberate, it makes the ITB signal clean instead of confounded by 5 hours of fatigue.
